Values, Vision, Ethos
In accordance with the Department for Education we aim to actively promote British values in schools to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain.
Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races and cultures with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.
The Key Values are:
In addition, at Highfield schools we also have specific school values which provide the principles by which we behave and act, helping us to live and learn happily together. Each half term we focus on a different value but remembering the importance of them all.
In the timetable below you can see each value that we focus on throughout the school year.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Headteacher - Highfields Infants' And Junior Schools
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Headteacher
Welcome to the Highfield Infants’ and Junior Schools website.
We are two separate schools, who work together to ensure children receive a consistent and cohesive primary education, from Reception through to the end of Year 6.
We are happy and friendly schools, who work closely with our families and local community to develop the whole child – emotionally, socially and academically. By offering a broad and balanced curriculum, alongside a wide range of extra-curricular clubs and other opportunities for children to take a very active role in school life, children leave Highfield confident and ready for their next stage of learning. We are incredibly proud of their many and varied achievements.
I hope you enjoy your visit to our website and find it a useful reference tool, as well as providing you with a flavour of what life is like at the Highfield schools.
Headteacher Highfield Infants’ and Highfield Junior School

English
At Highfield Schools, we want all children to develop a love of reading, writing and spoken language. Strong English skills help children succeed across the curriculum and beyond school. We introduce pupils to a diverse range of texts that reflect our community and broaden their understanding of the wider world. Through stories, poems and non‑fiction, children build empathy, creativity and confidence in expressing themselves.
By the time children leave Highfield Schools, they will:
Teachers assess learning through daily interactions, reading activities, written work and short assessments. Success is celebrated through displays, author events, reading celebrations and shared storytelling.

pageCache.text:
Mathematics
At Highfield Schools, we want children to become confident, fluent mathematicians who can solve problems, explain their thinking and apply their skills in real‑life situations. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in place value, number facts, times tables and arithmetic, helping children develop essential life skills and enjoyment in maths.
By the time they leave Highfield Schools, children:
Teachers assess learning through questioning, short tasks, practice activities and end‑of‑unit assessments. Children’s achievements are celebrated through displays, class sharing and recognition of effort, progress and problem‑solving.

By the time children leave Highfield, they will:

pageCache.pageTitle: Before & After School Club - Highfields Infants' And Junior Schools
pageCache.text:
Before & After School Club
Highfield Stars Before & After School Club
Highfield Infants' and Junior Schools launched our own before and after school club in September 2016 called Highfield Stars Club.
The club is sited at Highfield Infants' School and Junior School children are walked to the Infants' by a member of staff. Breakfast and afternoon snacks are provided by Stir Foods and a menu is included below.
Morning session: 7.45am to 8.45am, £7.90 per session (siblings £6.85)
Afternoon session: 3.15pm to 6.00pm, £17.30 per session (siblings £15.75)
If you would like your child to have a place please submit your booking form to Highfield Infants' School office.
or email us at stars@hfs.nestschools.org
Existing parents and carers may contact Stars club either by using the email address above, calling or texting 07921 535966 (calls and messages are not monitored outside of the club's operating times) or by leaving a message with the School office.
